subject: Key bug fix — reorderTasks index adjustment
content: Fixed reorderTasks in TaskManager: when moving an item forward (fromIndex < toIndex), the insertion index must be adjusted by -1 after splicing the item out of the array, because all subsequent elements shift left by one position after removal.

subject: Todo List App — Architecture
content: Application todo list complète dans scratch/index.html (HTML/CSS/JS monolithique). 10 modules JS : StateManager, TaskManager, CategoryManager, FilterManager, DragDropManager, ThemeManager, StatsManager, ExportImportManager, UIRenderer, EventHandlers. Persistance localStorage clé memoriX-todo. Zero dépendance externe. Tests dans scratch/tests/todo.test.js (Bun test + happy-dom). 60 tests, 164 assertions.

subject: Todo List — Interface Contracts
content: StateManager: getState/setState(partial)/save/load/reset/subscribe. TaskManager: addTask/updateTask/deleteTask/toggleTask/reorderTasks +/- subtask variants. CategoryManager: addCategory/updateCategory/deleteCategory/getCategories/getCategoryById. FilterManager: setStatus/setCategoryFilter/setSort/setSearch/getFilteredItems. ThemeManager: setTheme/toggleTheme/setAccentColor/applyTheme. StatsManager: getStats. ExportImportManager: exportData/importData/validateImportData. UIRenderer: render/renderTaskList/renderSidebar/renderStats/renderFilterBar.

subject: Todo App Test Suite — scratch/tests/todo.test.js
content: Comprehensive test suite created at scratch/tests/todo.test.js for the monolithic todo list app at scratch/index.html. Uses bun test with @happy-dom/global-registrator for DOM simulation. 60 tests, 158 expect() calls across 8 suites. Test structure: Suite A — StateManager (6 tests), Suite B — TaskManager (11 tests), Suite C — Subtasks (6 tests), Suite D — CategoryManager (7 tests), Suite E — FilterManager (7 tests), Suite F — ThemeManager (5 tests), Suite G — ExportImport (9 tests), Suite H — DOM Rendering (9 tests). Infrastructure: scratch/package.json, scratch/bunfig.toml (preloads happydom.ts), scratch/happydom.ts (HappyDOM v20.0.11). Tests require index.html to exist and expose managers on window: StateManager, TaskManager, CategoryManager, FilterManager, ThemeManager, ExportImportManager, UIRenderer.

subject: Todo List Application - Implementation Complete
content: The todo list application is complete at scratch/index.html (monolithic HTML/CSS/JS). All 60 tests pass across 9 suites: StateManager, TaskManager, Subtasks, CategoryManager, FilterManager, ThemeManager, ExportImport, DOM Rendering. Features: CRUD tasks, subtasks, categories with colors, due dates, filters (status/category/search/sort), drag-and-drop reordering, light/dark theme with accent color picker, export/import JSON, stats panel, toast notifications, mobile-responsive. Zero dependencies. Storage via localStorage key 'memoriX-todo'.

subject: Quadratic Equation Solver
content: Python quadratic solver at repo root: main.py with parse_args, format_equation, solve_quadratic, format_root, main. Tests: test_main.py with 17 pytest tests covering parsing, formatting, D>0/D==0/D<0 cases, and complex roots. All 17 tests pass.
